title: smime-tree: implement verify()
description: Signature verification is a core S/MIME operation. Implement in verify.rs: parse the application/pkcs7-signature DER blob as ContentInfo/SignedData (via cms crate); locate each SignerInfo; compute digest over signed_content bytes; verify signature against signer cert public key; validate cert chain via cert.rs. Return VerificationResult (signers with cert info, verified flag). RFC 5751 at ~/PROJECT/MIME/standards/rfc5751.txt, RFC 5652 at rfc5652.txt.
acceptance_criteria: verify() accepts OpenSSL-signed multipart/signed messages; rejects tampered content and expired certs
